questions.stem: Your log notes ruler legitimacy; which source strengthened a ruler's claim to rule?

options.text: Control of trade and patronage of learning

options.misconception: reverses the economic basis of power

questions.explanation: Control of trade and patronage of learning bolstered legitimacy. Isolation, destruction, or ignoring advisors would weaken it.

questions.subject: WORLD_HISTORY
questions.stem: You sketched sail shapes; explain why the lateen sail suited Indian Ocean winds.

answer.exemplar: The lateen sail could catch winds from various angles, letting dhows tack against monsoons and navigate coastal waters flexibly.

questions.explanation: Its triangular shape allowed sailing at angles to the wind. Square sails could not match this flexibility in shifting monsoons.
questions.hint: Focus on tacking and wind angles.

questions.stem: Your log records borrowed words; which process added Arabic words to Swahili?

options.text: A single decree replacing the language

questions.subject: WORLD_HISTORY
questions.stem: You noted gold's role; which statement best explains its value in trade?

options.text: It was heavy and impossible to carry
It had no value to anyone
It was scarce, portable, and widely accepted

questions.explanation: Gold's scarcity, portability, and acceptance made it valuable. Heaviness, worthlessness, or non-exchangeability would not explain its trade role.
